gamePackages.reason: the game's own code packages (Au*, Cr*, Chimera*, BP_*); a member name found only in these is the game's, used to catch a game read whose receiver this scan could not type

enginePackages.reason: UObject header and core engine layout (Index, Flags, Class, Name, Outer, TArray/FString/FName internals), identical across games
Unreal Engine runtime classes (actors, components, movement, controllers, widgets); read at their compiled engine layout on purpose, e.g. MaxWalkSpeed, Velocity
Gameplay Ability System types such as FGameplayAttributeData and FGameplayEffectSpec, engine code kept compiled on purpose
Mass Entity framework types (FMassEntityHandle Index/SerialNumber), engine layout
Epic's Common UI and Common Game plugins (activatable widgets, the UI policy and layouts), not the game's own code
